counterfactual_policy.label: D0_post_formal_naive_first_match
counterfactual_policy.matching: match only Domux output slots with frozen v1 registry semantics
counterfactual_policy.multi_action: process parsed lines sequentially against evolving state
counterfactual_policy.parse: parse every seven-slot line with the frozen v1 parser
counterfactual_policy.selection: select the first match in each scenario's pre-frozen inventory order

generation.method: deterministic replay of hash-bound frozen inputs; no timestamps

limitations: This arm was specified after formal v1 inspection and is diagnostic, not pre-registered evidence.
Inventory order is deterministic and pre-frozen but semantically arbitrary; first-match outcomes are order-dependent.
The fixed balanced conformance suite does not estimate production prevalence or risk.
The diagnostic uses the frozen in-memory adapter, not the separate real Home Assistant acceptance path.
The result does not replace, rename, or enter any formal B0/B1/B2 metric or significance test.
